items.title: Did Government of India invite applications for free laptops? PIB Fact Check debunks social media posts
items.snippet_en: The PIB Fact Check clarified on September 21, 2026, that the Government of India has not announced any "National Student Laptop Scheme 2026" or similar program providing free laptops to all students. Such claims are fake and part of a scam to collect personal information.

items.title: Free Laptop Scheme for Students
items.snippet_en: While some state-level free laptop schemes exist in India, such as Tamil Nadu's Ulagam Ungal Kaiyil and Uttar Pradesh's Swami Vivekananda Yuva Sashaktikaran Yojana (Mission DigiShakti), there is no central government scheme providing free laptops to all students.

items.title: Government refutes message of free laptop distribution under Student Laptop Scheme 2026
items.snippet_en: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check stated that the "National Student Laptop Scheme 2026" or any similar program providing free laptops to all students has not been announced by the Government of India. These claims are fake and a scam.
Claims circulating on social media about a free laptop scheme are fake and part of a scam to collect personal information.

items.title: UP Free Laptop Yojana

items.snippet_en: The PIB Fact Check has repeatedly debunked claims about a "PM Free Laptop Scheme" or "National Student Laptop Scheme 2026," confirming these are scams designed to collect personal information. They advise citizens to verify information through official government sources.

outputs.notes_en: The claims about the 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026' are false. The Indian government's official fact-checking agency, PIB Fact Check, has clarified that no such scheme exists and that these claims are part of a scam to collect personal information. While some state-level laptop schemes are in place, there is no central government program providing free laptops to all students. The website mentioned in the claim was found to be blocked, indicating its fraudulent nature.
